findings.title: Removing the postfix does not close the run #31 missed fire breath discovery; don't report it fixed
findings.detail: The removed doc comment said the Ability.Activate postfix existed because Notify_PawnUsedVerb 'missed fire breath casts in testing (run #31)'. For TF_Example_FireBreath (Verb_CastAbility), both hooks run in the same Verb.TryCastNextBurstShot call: TryCastShot calls Ability.Activate, then Verb.cs:497 calls health.Notify_UsedVerb. Both pass through the same TitanTrait.TryDiscoverBy check (TitanTrait.cs:53). So taking the postfix out neither causes nor fixes that miss. The cause is still unknown: either PlayerCanObserve returning false on a fogged cell, or the discovery message belonging to the pawn that was hit (build 33 review). Say the bug is still open when reporting done, not resolved.

findings.title: World-target abilities cast from a caravan no longer trigger UsesGrantedAbility
findings.detail: Ability.cs:659 calls Activate(GlobalTargetInfo) directly when the pawn is in a caravan. That skips the verb, so Notify_PawnUsedVerb never runs. The removed Patch_AbilityActivate_Global covered this case. It is an edge case for AI titan creatures, and none of the example traits grant a world-target ability, so this is worth knowing only if a content mod grants one.
